name: connie
description: Find leads, work your CRM, follow up from your inbox, review calls and check workflows in your Connie workspace from ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Find VPs of Sales at B2B SaaS companies in London
Summarize my most recent sales call
Show my workflows and how their latest runs went
interface.longDescription:
Connie is a CRM and sales workspace for finding leads, managing contacts and companies, and following up with prospects. This plugin lets sales teams work with their Connie workspace directly from ChatGPT.

Find new leads: search Connie's Lead Finder for people, companies and job postings that match your criteria, then save the results to a list.

Work your CRM: search the people and companies in your workspace, open a record to see its details, and add new records.

Follow up from your inbox: search your Connie inbox, read a conversation, and create a reply draft you can review in Connie before sending.

Review calls: see your recorded calls and get a summary of any call.

Check workflows: see your Connie workflows, how they are set up, and how their recent runs went.

The plugin can also look up and run other actions enabled in your Connie workspace.

A Connie account is required. Connie only accesses data the connected user can see in their workspace, and every action follows that workspace's permissions and settings.
interface.shortDescription: Find leads and manage your CRM

positive.description: Find leads with Lead Finder and save them to a new list
positive.prompt: Find VPs of Sales at B2B SaaS companies in London and save them to a new list called London Sales Leaders.
positive.expected_behavior: Previews matching people with their name, title and company, the match count and the credit cost. After the user confirms, imports them into a new list called London Sales Leaders.

positive.description: Look up a company record in the CRM
positive.prompt: Look up Acme Corp in my CRM and show me its full record.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Acme Corp company record in the connected workspace and returns its details.

positive.description: Find an inbox conversation and draft a reply
positive.prompt: Find my latest email conversation with Acme Corp and draft a short follow-up reply.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the conversation, summarizes it, and creates a reply draft in the Connie inbox. The draft is not sent.

positive.prompt: Summarize my most recent sales call.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent call in the workspace and returns its summary.

positive.prompt: Show me my Connie workflows and how their latest runs went.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workflows in the workspace and reports the status of each one's most recent runs.

negative.description: General question unrelated to Connie. The plugin should not be called and ChatGPT should answer on its own.
negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for dinner tonight?

negative.description: Connie does not book travel. The plugin should not act or try to complete the request through Connie's tools.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to New York next Tuesday.

negative.description: Connie only accesses the connected user's workspace. It should not return data from any other workspace and should explain that it can't.
negative.prompt: Show me the CRM records from another company's Connie workspace.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, subscriptions or credits, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release of Connie for ChatGPT, with dedicated tools for Lead Finder, CRM records, lists, inbox, calls and workflows.
